text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's finally time, isn't it. 
Starting today, those wagashi will be on 
the shelves...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! From today until Valentine's Day 
itself, 
let's sprint full speed ahead with 
everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... please don't push yourself too 
hard, though. 
Our concept is 'A leisurely time with your 
loved ones,' after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoops, that's true enough.

text_block_list.name: Yukino & Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*... *exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All the wagashi are on display! 
Preparations for opening are complete!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan, shall we change into our 
customer service outfits too? 
It's the last weekend before Valentine's, 
so it's going to get busy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Customers were already lining up outside, 
so I handed out order sheets! 
I'll go change real quick too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And with that... we are open!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Welcome, everyone! We are now open!

text_block_list.name: Stylish Customer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how lovely...! The inside of the shop 
is decorated too. 
The displays are so elaborate... I don't 
know where to look first!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to try our brand-new 
wagashi releasing today? 
Please, have a sample!

text_block_list.name: Stylish Customer
text_block_list.text:
Don't mind if I do. ...*chew chew*... Oh 
my, what a gentle flavor! 
It looks so gorgeous, yet tastes so 
nostalgic... It's so comforting.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
We brought out the inherent 'radiance' of 
wagashi even more. 
It goes wonderfully with green tea. 
Please, enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Child of Family
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!? This sweet is crackling inside my 
mouth! 
What is this? That's so fun!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Were you surprised? That sweet is 
a surprise box! 
And the flowers around it are for adults! 
It's perfect for family snack time!

text_block_list.name: Father of Family
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow, so it has pieces for both adults 
and kids. 
Maybe I'll buy one as a souvenir for Mom 
and the others.

text_block_list.name: Female Customer in Couple
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, which sweet is the one made for 
two people to share? 
The one from the flyer, um...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That would be the 'Spring Orchid & Autumn 
Chrysanthemum'... Right this way. 
Will you be taking one today...?

text_block_list.name: Male Customer in Couple
text_block_list.text:
"One 'Geranium', and one 'Sprint' and 
'Ing' each, please! 
I ate them before during that Japanese 
sweets showdown, and they were so good!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"One 'Geranium', one 'Sprint', and one 
'Ing'... Certainly. 
Thank you very much, I'll wrap them up for 
you right away..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, is this for your family? 
If so, how about our 'Hundred Flowers in 
Bloom'? We have samples available if you'd 
like to try."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Please, take your time and savor it. 
With someone precious to you, in a 
relaxed, peaceful moment—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. The kind of Japanese sweets 
I love... 
Let older folks and little kids alike 
share the very same peaceful time.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Existing right alongside someone's happy 
memories—)

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you all for your hard work. ...You 
really did something amazing. 
I wonder how many decades it's been since 
so many people crowded into this shop."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe... It's the result of all of us 
joinin' forces. 
Plus, it only worked 'cause your sweets 
were so delicious in the first place!"

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"...Watching you all work so hard reminded 
me. 
This shop has always been what gave my 
life purpose."

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I suppose I'll keep going until my 
legs give out. 
—Truly, thank you."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"G-Grandma...!  
We should be the ones... sayin' thank 
you!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Waaaaaaaah!! I'm so glad for youuuuu! 
I'm so moooved!!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'radiance' has been restored. 
I'm glad it wasn't lost."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Yaaaaay!!!! 
This calls for a huge celebration! Give me 
30 sakura mochi to celebrate!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't think we even have the 
ingredients left. 
We've sold out of everything... Hehe."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"What?! Then I shall come buy some again 
another time!!"

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Sure. I'll prepare some extra-special 
sweets and be waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Great work today, Yukino-san.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Aw no, you worked just as hard, Cafe-san. 
I'm just... so, so glad the shop's stayin' 
open..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if our customers are 
relaxin' and enjoyin' their sweets right 
about now."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Today is Valentine's Day... after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, well. Not that I'm tryin' to 
say we should do the same, 
but, you know... Here..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"It ain't fancy like what Flight-san and 
the others make, 
but I tried makin' some again..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
Fufu, to tell you the truth, I also..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, you too, Cafe-san?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Now that things with the shop have 
settled down...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought it would be nice... 
to spend a calm, leisurely time with 
someone precious to me."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Ahaha. Gosh, I feel 
the exact same way too."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, shall we enjoy them like we 
always do? 
I'll go get the tea leaves and plates."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Just like always. For our calm, 
peaceful time together.
